AuthFrame.closedAccess: Closed access: accounts are created by your school or instructor.
AuthFrame.setupNote: First run: this page closes once the first account exists.

email.title: Sign in
email.description: Enter the email address your account uses and we will send you a 6-digit sign-in code.
email.label: Email address

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to this address. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

blocked.unknownBody: Accounts are created by your school or instructor. If you should have access, ask them to invite you.
blocked.blockedBody: Signing in is disabled for this account. Contact your school or instructor.

errors.botCheckFailed: The security check did not pass. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.deliveryFailed: We could not send the code. Try again shortly; if it keeps failing, contact your school.
errors.invalidCode: That code does not match. {attemptsLeft, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Request a new code.

passkeyErrors.notFound: No passkey for this site was found on this device. Sign in with a code, then save one in Settings.
passkeyErrors.failed: Signing in with a passkey did not work. Use an email code instead.

githubErrors.notLinked: This GitHub account is not linked to an account here. Sign in with a code, then link GitHub in Settings.
githubErrors.denied: GitHub access was not granted. Try again or sign in with a code.
githubErrors.blocked: Signing in is disabled for this account. Contact your school or instructor.
githubErrors.failed: Signing in with GitHub did not work. Try again or sign in with a code.
githubErrors.redirectFailed: Could not reach GitHub. Try again shortly.

passkeyOffer.title: Sign in with one touch next time
passkeyOffer.body: Save this device and sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of waiting for a code. Codes keep working if you lose the device.
passkeyOffer.note: If you choose “Not now”, we will not ask again on this device. You can save it any time in Settings.
passkeyOffer.failed: The device could not be saved. You can try again in Settings.

Setup.title: Set up {appName}
Setup.description: Create the first account. It becomes the platform administrator and the owner of your organization.
Setup.name: Your name
Setup.emailHint: You will sign in with a code sent here, so it must receive email.
Setup.doneBody: Your account and organization are ready. Sign in with a code sent to {email}.

errors.alreadySetUp: This instance is already set up. Sign in instead.

Home.roleIn: You are {role, select, owner {the owner} admin {an administrator} instructor {an instructor} other {a student}} in {organization}.
Home.noOrganizationBody: Your account is not a member of any organization. Ask your school or instructor to add you.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of waiting for a code. Email codes keep working if you lose a device.
passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? You will no longer be able to sign in with it on that device.
passkeys.privacy: Your fingerprint or face never leaves your device; this site only receives a public key. Passkeys are bound to this site's address, so a fake site cannot use them.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.

errors.failed: The device could not be saved. Try again.
errors.renameFailed: The name could not be changed.
errors.removeFailed: The passkey could not be removed.

github.title: GitHub
github.body: Link your GitHub account to sign in with it. Only read access to your profile is requested.
github.unlinkConfirm: Unlink GitHub? You can still sign in with an email code.
github.linkFailed: Could not reach GitHub. Try again shortly.
github.notConfigured: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this instance.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.count: {count, plural, one {# open session} other {# open sessions}}
sessions.signOutOthersConfirm: Sign out every session except this one?
sessions.revokeConfirm: Sign out {device}? It will need to sign in again.
sessions.stale: For your security, open sessions are listed only shortly after signing in. Sign out and back in to see and end them.
sessions.failed: The session could not be ended.
sessions.note: There are no passwords here: every sign-in uses a one-time code, a passkey or a linked GitHub account. If you see a session you do not recognise, sign it out.

signInCode.subject: {code} is your sign-in code for {appName}
signInCode.heading: Your sign-in code
signInCode.intro: Use this code to finish signing in to {appName}.
signInCode.expiry: The code expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
signInCode.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without this code.
